claims.claim: Root Cause F42-F45 verified: (1) TableDebouncer.workerLoop in debounce.go:185-214 only drained td.tasks on td.ctx.Done() while abandoning batches in td.flushCh and not waiting on in-flight runTransmute goroutines; (2) Multi-hour jobs across Snapshot, Transmute, and Transform lacked soft-stop chunk-boundary pause (PAUSED) and startup/watchdog auto-resume; (3) CancelTransmute in master_transmute_job_handler.go:121 and RequestCancel in transmute_job_repo.go:200-208 only set cancel_requested=true and updated_at=NOW() without transitioning PENDING/PAUSED/stale jobs to CANCELLED, without closing transmute_schedule, and without publishing cdc.cmd.transmute-cancel.

claims.claim: Solution P13 implements Two-Tier Graceful Shutdown: Tier 1 drains 100% of in-flight micro-batches in BatchBuffer and TableDebouncer before DB close; Tier 2 uses a soft-stop atomic.Bool flag across SnapshotRunner, TransmuterModule/TransmuteHandler, and BatchTransformHandler so the current 1000-row chunk (~300ms) finishes cleanly, saves its checkpoint (last_seen_id / last_gpay_id) with status=PAUSED, and automatically resumes on worker startup or 30s watchdog tick.

claims.claim: Solution P13 fixes transmute-cancel end-to-end by immediately transitioning PENDING, PAUSED, or stale RUNNING (>45s without heartbeat) jobs to CANCELLED in RequestCancel, closing transmute_schedule.last_status='cancelled', publishing cdc.cmd.transmute-cancel to the worker, and registering HandleTransmuteCancel to cancel active job contexts immediately.
